No — Batch 7 ships November 30, 2026, and the queue goes in order. There's no way to jump it.

If you want something running sooner, the Hammer Thor P2 (10 TH/s, ~166 W, $369) is in stock and ships within about 5 business days. Smaller machine, but it's mining this month.
